welcome.title: Inventory Management System
welcome.description: Explore the interactive catalog, manage stock levels, and test real-time operations without signing up.
welcome.guest_alert_desc: You are accessing via an anonymous session in an isolated sandbox. All created records will be permanently purged after 10 minutes of continuous inactivity.
welcome.features_title: What can you test in this demo?
welcome.feature_crud_desc: Creation, update, code/name lookup, and hard deletion of inventory stock items.
welcome.feature_isolation_desc: Your dataset remains invisible to other evaluators testing the application at the same time.
welcome.feature_lifecycle_desc: Reactive memory cleanup supported by passive orphan resource sweeps.

dashboard.title: Inventory Control
dashboard.subtitle: Manage your stock items in this isolated sandbox.
dashboard.empty_desc: Start by adding your first item using the button above.
